7.1.description: Monod-type specific growth rate is limited by glucose and glutamine and inhibited by lactate and ammonia.
7.1.quote: The Monod equation is based on the availability of limiting nutrients (such as glucose and glutamine) and inhibitors (such as lactate and ammonia) in a concentration-dependent pattern.
